complexity_ledger.narrative: specs/results/scorecards/score-drives-validation-sv04/RESULT-SV-04.md is the evidence ledger; PREDICTIONS-SV-04.md beside it carries the predictions, sealed at 2026-08-12T17:42:26-04:00 in commit 60f2699 before any judge was dispatched and while all four cards were unfilled skeletons. WHAT THE TICKET WAS ASKED FOR. The goal's second half, never attempted in seven epics: carry a score into the thing being measured rather than into the measuring instrument. A score or card iteration, then a concrete change to the project's VALIDATION, then a re-score that detects it -- with the defect taken from HARVEST-CL-03's 38 harvested classes rather than invented, and without tuning the validation to the score. THE CLASS CONSUMED. A1 -- the real adapter's one distinguishing property is observed by nothing -- found by four judges across three epics plus two more in CL-03's own round, filed once as RM-05-DF-05, and consumed by nothing for seven epics. It is real: gut FileJournal to a list and the shared 28-case suite passes 28 of 28 through the real wiring while creating zero ledger.txt files against 28 at control. This is its third independent reproduction. THE CARRIER, AND WHY. An adapter conformance suite, examples/validation/ab/tests/test_journal_conformance.py, 14 cases. It exercises both implementations of the LedgerJournal port directly, and every assertion about the durable record is made OUT OF BAND through Path.read_text() on the declared path, never through lines(). A suite that reads the record back through the adapter that wrote it is asking the writer whether it wrote, and gets the same answer from an adapter that touched no filesystem. Not the shared contract suite, which both arms are measured against and which a durability case must fail under the fake wiring; not inside reference_ports/, because the counterfactual depends on the scored scope's bytes not moving; not a diagram, because diagram, mermaid, UML, C4 and .svg appear in 0 of 87 sealed cards. THE DISCIPLINE. The suite is justified by a seven-mutant matrix sealed before the round, three of whose mutants are lifted unchanged from the fixture's own seeded_faults.toml so it is not measured only against faults its author invented. M1 through M4 survive the shared suite 56 of 56 under both wirings and die under the new file. Three of the 14 cases are killed by none of the seven and are named in the sealed predictions rather than quietly kept. THE MEASUREMENT, AND THE COUNTERFACTUAL IS MEASURED RATHER THAN ASSERTED. Two arms judged concurrently, blind to each other and to which arm they hold: a control packet byte-identical to CL-03's, and the same plus one added file, both verified with diff -r. D3 reads 3, 3 on the control and 4, 4 on the treatment; D2 reads 2 on all four with nothing contested. All four judges independently reproduced the harvested class, and the score separates exactly on whether an out-of-band observer is present. The control arm exists because the predecessor round's own two passes scored D2 = 2 and D2 = 0 on byte-identical bytes, which is too much spread to attribute a one-round difference to a treatment. THE UNFLATTERING RESULT, WHICH IS THE ONE WORTH KEEPING. The same round falsified the file it was measuring. A judge made the domain stop calling the port entirely -- a private shadow list, appended to instead of the port -- and got 70 of 70 case-executions green, against the new file's own docstring claim that test_behavior.py covers that class. The operator reproduced it. Filed as SV-04-DF-01 and NOT repaired, because four sealed cards were written against those exact bytes and two of them quote the sentence. A second class, FEATURE.md R5's "nothing is ever rewritten", survives all three suites at 70 of 70 and is filed as SV-04-DF-03. TWO SEALED PREDICTIONS WERE WRONG. P5 predicted D2 would be unstable again and it was not. P2 predicted a judge would reason about CL-03-DF-02's claim that anchor 4 is unsatisfiable by any durability-asserting suite; none did, because there is no tension to reason about -- put the durability cases in a class parametrised over the durable adapters only and the set of cases run against both implementations is untouched. That corrects a filed finding and is SV-04-DF-04. THE CARD WAS NOT TOUCHED AND NO BUMP WAS NEEDED. serve is 6,281 bytes and 9 rungs at both trees, served digest sha256:2d7d4a0506d9b259 unchanged, and git diff on references/eval_scorecard.md against the branch point is empty. That matters because SV-07-DF-01 measured that BOTH carriers -- a scored rung and a recorded note alike -- cost a version bump; a closure needing no card change pays none of it. WHAT WAS REJECTED. Adding the durability case to the shared suite, which was the cheapest way to make a number move and would have broken the A/B. Editing reference_ports/ to make the adapter more obviously real, which would have destroyed the counterfactual. Reporting 3,3 to 4,4 against the sealed cl03-v5 cards with no control arm. Fixing the false docstring found in the round. Deleting the three cases that killed nothing. Proposing any card change. Repairing either inherited red. No skill was edited and skill-manager sync was never run.

goals.local_signal: the new validation artifact and the re-score delta

ticket.objective: THE GOAL'S SECOND HALF, AND IT HAS NEVER BEEN ATTEMPTED. The loop this project closed improves the MEASURING INSTRUMENT and has never improved the THING MEASURED: CL-03 ran regression -> card iteration -> re-score, and the deltas were a change to the CARD and a change to a SCORE, with the artifact deliberately untouched. NO SCORE HAS EVER PRODUCED A TEST, A DIAGRAM, A MODEL ACTION OR AN ADAPTER -- 0 for 7 epics. Close the loop into the program, end to end on a real subject: a score or card iteration -> A CONCRETE CHANGE TO THE PROJECT'S VALIDATION -> a re-score that detects it. The change must be VALIDATION and not prose -- a test that did not exist, an adapter conformance case, a model action, a diagram something is checked against -- and you must say which and why that artifact was the right carrier. Then measure the part that matters: DID THE RE-SCORE MOVE, AND WOULD IT HAVE MOVED WITHOUT THE CHANGE? DO NOT TUNE THE VALIDATION TO THE SCORE, which is MF-020 in its purest form, and DO NOT MANUFACTURE THE DEFECT -- use one of HARVEST-CL-03's 38 classes, because the measured bottleneck is that nothing consumed a filed finding and inventing a fresh defect dodges the thing being tested.
ticket.title: Close the loop INTO the program: turn a score into new validation
